verdict.rationale: Casium's organization offering is built for running many employee cases through one provider. It provides a dedicated attorney and case team per account, a platform showing "exactly where every case stands," a "live view of your entire program," and one source of truth for compliance, billing and reporting across employees, backed by a real client portal. Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on corroboration of the multi-case dashboard, concrete documentation of its features (bulk onboarding, per-employee tracking detail, volume pricing), and any stated startup/scale-up program.
